action: The CSA urges young people to be careful when interacting with strangers online, to avoid taking or sharing intimate photos and videos, and to report suspected online sexual exploitation to the CSA by call, text or email.
date_note: Date is the day Starr FM published the CSA's announcement; the page gives no earlier announcement day. The CSA says the arrests took place on 13 and 15 November.
exec: Ghana's Cyber Security Authority says it and partners arrested two men over alleged sextortion and charged them under the Cybersecurity Act, 2020.
geo_basis: Accra, where the Cyber Security Authority's release says the arrests were made
plain: Ghana's cyber agency says it arrested two young men in Accra over alleged sextortion: one of a schoolgirl, one of an ex-girlfriend. Both are charged.
summary: Ghana's Cyber Security Authority (CSA), with other security agencies, arrested two men in Accra over alleged sextortion, according to the CSA's release as reported by Starr FM and The Herald Ghana. One allegedly blackmailed a schoolgirl with nude images; the other allegedly threatened to publish videos of his estranged girlfriend. The CSA says both are charged with sextortion under Section 66(2) of the Cybersecurity Act, 2020.
title: Ghana's CSA and partners arrest two in Accra over alleged sextortion

validation.note: Starr FM Ghana and The Herald Ghana, two independent publishers, each report the CSA's announcement of the arrests and charges; the CSA's own page was not read.

review.note: plain said women; sources say a 16-year-old schoolgirl and an 18-year-old ex-girlfriend; fixed. Date, charges, action, validation match Starr FM and Herald
